_doc: Gold standard for reranker-selection eval. Copy to gold_dataset.json and fill one entry per query. gold_chunk_keys are the ArangoDB _key values of chunks that SHOULD be retrieved (find them via dump_chunks.py or an AQL browse). categoryLabel/serviceLabels/language mirror the payload the backend sends to chatqna (drives label-filtered retrieval) — keep them faithful to a real user flow.
